meta_description: AJ's Autolocks Birmingham offers 24/7 emergency lockout services, lock repairs, and key cutting. Fast response, competitive rates. Call now.
hero_eyebrow: 24/7 Emergency Response — Lock Outs, Repairs & Fitting
hero_subhead: We arrive within the hour, any time of day or night. No call-out charge if we can't help.
services_subhead: From emergency lock-outs to new installations and repairs, we handle every lock problem.

services.title: Emergency Lock-Out
services.desc: Locked yourself out? We arrive within an hour, any time of day or night. No damage to your door — we use professional non-destructive entry methods.

services.title: Locks Repaired & Fitted
services.desc: Worn locks, broken keys, or damaged mechanisms? We repair on the spot or fit new high-security locks to your home or business.

services.title: Cylinder & Mortice Locks
services.desc: Specialise in fitting mortice locks and replacing cylinders. All work guaranteed — we use only quality locks that last.

services.title: Key Cutting
services.desc: Need spare keys quickly? We cut keys on the spot for most domestic and commercial locks. Same-day service, competitive pricing.

services.title: Broken Key Extraction
services.desc: Snapped key stuck in the lock? We remove it safely without damaging the mechanism and can cut you a new key on site.

services.title: Business Lock-Out
services.desc: Locked out of your shop or office? Rapid response to get you trading again. We handle chains, shutters, and fire-exit doors.

about_pullquote: I started this business solving the lockouts that frustrated me. That's still our mission today.
about_para_1: AJ's Autolocks has been serving Birmingham and the surrounding areas for nearly three decades. We began as a one-man operation and have grown into a trusted team of fully qualified locksmiths, all trained to tackle emergencies calmly and quickly. Every member carries the tools needed to get you back inside without damage or fuss.
about_para_2: We've built our reputation on being there when you need us most — at midnight or midday — and charging fairly for it. Customers choose us because we don't inflate our prices just because it's an emergency. We're local, we're honest, and we work around the clock so you don't have to.
reviews_heading: What Birmingham Customers Say About Us

reviews.text: Locked out of my flat at 2am on a Saturday. Rang AJ's thinking I'd be waiting hours. Bloke was here in 40 minutes, got me in without any damage to the door, and didn't charge a fortune. Brilliant service.
reviews.author: Marcus T.

reviews.text: Used them for a broken lock on my shop door. They came out same day, fitted a new mortice lock, and left me with two spare keys. Professional job, fair price, and they cleaned up after themselves. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Sophie K.

reviews.text: Had a snapped key stuck in my front door. Thought I'd need the door forced open. They extracted it cleanly and cut me a new key on the spot. Couldn't fault them. Will definitely call AJ's again.
reviews.author: David R.
